products.name: EZ Guys Complete
products.subtitle: Adobe Premiere Pro workflow toolkit
products.description: A compact collection of workflow tools for creating reusable clip packs, arranging selected clips, and fitting the active sequence to your work.

items.title: RCP Library
items.description: Create reusable clip packs, manage a library, and import packs into other Premiere projects.

items.title: Align
items.description: Align selected clips to a sequence or group reference using six directional alignment operations and an adjustable offset.

items.title: Distribute

topics.title: Overview
topics.summary: What EZ Guys is and where to start.

blocks.text: EZ Guys is a Premiere Pro UXP toolkit focused on reusable content, clip alignment, distribution, and sequence framing.
The source manifest describes Premiere Pro 25.6.0 as the minimum host version. The website is a documentation preview while the product is in development.
This website documents observed controls in the current development source. Behavior, availability, and compatibility should be verified again before public release.

blocks.text: RCP Library provides a workflow to create a reusable pack from project content, choose a library folder, browse saved packs, and import them into a Premiere project.

items: Open the RCP Library panel or the RCP tools in EZ Guys.
Connect a library location and review the available packs.
Use Create RCP to prepare a reusable pack; review the source-asset requirements first.
Import a saved pack into your active project when needed.

blocks.text: The current implementation recognizes asset modes such as Bundled, Library Linked, and Assetless, with project-local tracking for imported packs.
RCP features depend on the clip pack and its underlying media. Test your own projects before relying on a pack in production.

screenshots.caption: Demo asset — replace with an approved Align screenshot.

blocks.text: Align provides Top, Vertical Center, Bottom, Left, Horizontal Center, and Right operations for the selected clips.

items: Select one or more supported clips in the active Premiere sequence.
Choose Sequence or Group alignment where the UI provides that option.
Pick the direction or center axis.
Use the Offset field when you need additional spacing from the chosen alignment target.

blocks.text: The offset uses pixels. Positive and negative values affect placement relative to the selected alignment target.

screenshots.alt: Placeholder preview for the Distribute tool
screenshots.caption: Demo asset — replace with an approved Distribute screenshot.

blocks.text: Distribute includes Vertical Top, Center, and Bottom; Horizontal Left, Center, and Right; plus Horizontal Spacing and Vertical Spacing.

items: Choose an axis-based distribute operation to position the selection.
Choose spacing mode when your goal is to make the gaps between clips consistent.
Review the resulting positions and adjust your selection as needed.

blocks.text: Spacing and axis distribution are different operations. Try both when composing repeated elements.

topics.title: Sequence Fit
topics.summary: Frame the sequence around selected material.

screenshots.alt: Placeholder preview for the Sequence Fit tool
screenshots.caption: Demo asset — replace with an approved Sequence Fit screenshot.

blocks.text: Sequence Fit displays a Target Frame Size preview and supports Source and Bounds modes.

items: Open the Sequence Utility panel or the Sequence Fit card.
Select one or more compatible clips.
Inspect the Target Frame Size preview and apply the operation.

blocks.text: Sequence Fit changes sequence framing. It is not AI upscaling and does not invent new pixel detail.
EZ Guys is developed as an Adobe Premiere Pro UXP plugin. In the development source, its manifest specifies Premiere Pro 25.6.0 or later.
For development testing, the UXP Developer Tool can load the plugin through its manifest. A public distribution and installation guide will be added when the release package is available.
Public downloads, supported operating systems, and licensing details are not published here yet.
Is EZ Guys available for purchase? Not yet listed through this website. The product is currently marked In development.
Will there be standalone products? They are under consideration, but the website does not present unannounced products or prices as final.
Where can I see the demo? A YouTube demo can be enabled on the product page, while approved screenshots can be added to each tool's documentation topic.
